description: Single-line substring replacements whose untouched prefix and suffix must survive both the literal edit and the whole-line candidate.

cases.name: substring edit preserves untouched prefix and suffix

input.sourceText:
const total = price * qty;
return total;

expected.editedText:
const total = unitPrice * qty;
return total;

wrongEditedText.endColumnTreatedAsInclusive:
const total = unitPrice* qty;
return total;
wrongEditedText.columnsTreatedAsZeroBased:
const total = punitPrice* qty;
return total;

cases.name: explicit equal endLine addresses a substring on a later line
